refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The CLICOLOR environment variable, when set, tells programs that understand terminal colours to emit control sequences to change colours and other graphic renditions. Such programs are to emit those control sequences if either the device file to which they are writing is a terminal device as determined by the isatty3 library function, or the CLICOLOR_FORCE environment variable is set.
The control sequences to emit are determined by the values of the TERM7 and COLORTERM7 environment variables.

The usual place to define CLICOLOR is in the system‐wide or the per‐user login.conf5 database, in the setenv capability. This is then picked up at user login time when userenv-fromenv1 is run with its --set-other command‐line option.
